description: Resource Type definition for AWS::SecurityAgent::PrivateConnection. A private connection allows Security Agent to reach a target resource privately via a VPC Lattice resource gateway.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag.

ServiceManaged.description: The configuration for a service-managed private connection, where the service manages the resource gateway lifecycle.

HostAddress.description: The IP address or DNS name of the target resource.

VpcId.description: The VPC to create the service-managed resource gateway in.

SubnetIds.description: The subnets that the service-managed resource gateway spans.

SecurityGroupIds.description: The security groups to attach to the service-managed resource gateway.

IpAddressType.description: The IP address type of the service-managed resource gateway.

Ipv4AddressesPerEni.description: The number of IPv4 addresses in each elastic network interface for the service-managed resource gateway.

PortRanges.description: The TCP port ranges that a consumer can use to access the resource.

DnsResolution.description: The DNS resolution mode for the resource gateway.

SelfManaged.description: The configuration for a self-managed private connection, where you manage your own resource configuration.

ResourceConfigurationId.description: The identifier or ARN of the resource configuration.

Mode.description: The configuration for the private connection. Specify either a service-managed or a self-managed mode.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the private connection.

PrivateConnectionName.description: A unique name for the private connection within your account.

Certificate.description: The PEM-encoded certificate chain for the private connection.

Type.description: The type of the private connection, indicating whether it is service-managed or self-managed.

Status.description: The current status of the private connection.

ResourceGatewayId.description: The identifier or ARN of the VPC Lattice resource gateway.

HostAddress.description: The IP address or DNS name of the target resource.

VpcId.description: The identifier of the VPC the resource gateway is created in.

ResourceConfigurationId.description: The identifier or ARN of the VPC Lattice resource configuration.

CertificateExpiryTime.description: The date and time the connection's certificate expires, in UTC format.

DnsResolution.description: The DNS resolution mode for the resource gateway.

Tags.description: The tags attached to the private connection.
